synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a high-ROIC cash-generative franchise at its own valuation floor, but with revenue now contracting and fundamentals materially below peers.

bull_points.claim: At 7.5x TEV/LTM EBITDA the name sits at the 0th percentile of its own 20-quarter history and P/E sits at the 1.4th percentile of ~5y — a multiple at its own-history floor that POSES (not answers) whether this is overshoot.

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has RISEN through the margin compression — Dec-31-2021 1,148 → Mar-31-2026 (LTM) 1,337 — so the falling margin % is not a falling EBITDA dollar; the % is the optical read, the rising dollar is the reconciler.

bull_points.claim: On the fundamental_deltas the name's LT EPS growth (14% vs peer-median 12%) and beta (0.9 vs 0.9) are AT OR ABOVE peers, posing whether the full discount is fully earned by the weaker growth/margin legs or partly residual — the human judges.

bear_points.claim: The de-rate is sharply idiosyncratic, not a market move: the name returned -49.9% over 180d while IWM returned +18.0%, a -65.8% relative gap concentrated on the name.

Top-line growth has stalled into a decline — revenue YoY -1.5% (Q1 Mar-31-2026 vs Q1 Mar-31-2025) — and LTM revenue 6,474 has slipped below FY2025's 6,497, so this is not merely margin optics: the dollar base is now contracting.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: The EBITDA-margin slide is real and multi-year — 24% (2021) → 20% (2025) — and on growth/margin fundamentals the name is materially worse than peers (EBITDA margin 21% vs peer-median 31%; rev growth 2% vs 8%; EBITDA growth 2% vs 7%), so much of the peer discount is EARNED, not a clean overshoot.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: Revenue estimate breadth is negative — FY2026 Revenue 0 up / 3 down last month — and the gap traces to a discrete 2026-02-03 earnings+Reg-FD 8-K, consistent with a fundamentals-driven reset rather than noise.
Revenue is heavily concentrated in one segment — Insights 5,073 (78%) of 6,497 — so any deceleration in the subscription/CV engine drives the whole result.
On the fundamental_deltas leverage is also worse than peers (Debt/EBITDA 2.4 vs peer-median 1.8), partly justifying the discount on the balance-sheet leg.

twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: High-retention subscription/recurring-data franchise that de-rated on a cyclical demand pause yet held pricing power and re-rated as growth resumed.

twin_reference_cases.name: Verisk Analytics
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: Recurring-revenue analytics moat that absorbed a growth scare without structural erosion of its subscription base.

twin_reference_cases.name: Gartner Inc
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: Same name previously de-rated on a federal/government and macro demand shock, then re-accelerated contract value as decision-making normalized.

twin_reference_cases.name: FactSet Research Systems
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: Subscription financial-data provider that saw decelerating net new business and multiple compression but retained sticky customers.

twin_reference_cases.name: Nielsen Holdings
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: Information/measurement franchise whose stalled organic growth and rising leverage led to a prolonged de-rate and eventual take-private rather than a re-rate.

decisive_question.question: Is the contract-value/revenue stall a temporary geopolitical- and federal-driven deferral that re-accelerates (overshoot), or the start of a structural deceleration of the Insights subscription engine that earns the peer discount (value trap)?

evidence_for.claim: Management frames the slowdown as client decisions slowing 'somewhat in March' due to the geopolitical environment, with CV growth said to have ACCELERATED in Q1 and expected to accelerate further.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Gartner, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 05, 2026.rtf; Gartner, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 03, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: ROIC firmed to 19.4% LTM and absolute EBITDA rose to 1,337 LTM, inconsistent with a franchise in structural decay.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

evidence_for.claim: LT EPS growth at 14% is above the peer median of 12%, suggesting the long-run earnings trajectory the market is pricing may exceed the implied discount.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

evidence_against.claim: Revenue is already YoY -1.5% and LTM revenue has slipped below FY2025, so the deceleration has crossed into outright contraction at the reporting line.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

evidence_against.claim: Forward revenue revisions are negative (FY2026 0 up / 3 down), and the consensus recommendation is a Hold (3.00), with management itself describing a 'much tougher selling environment' of deferred decision-making.
Margin and growth fundamentals are materially below peers (margin 21% vs 31%; rev growth 2% vs 8%), indicating much of the discount is earned.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)
